articles.title: Transferable Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack on Black-Box Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving

articles.title: Benchmarking the Personalization Capabilities of Large Language Models
articles.summary: The paper introduces SDR-Arena and SDR-Bench, a benchmark and public corpus designed to test whether LLMs can personalize sales messaging for independent buyers based on pre-outcome information. The best cited model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, recovered 55.8% of winning sales content, and professional SDRs rated only 48% of generated pitches usable without editing. The authors find the main limitation is retrieval rather than reasoning, as models improve when given relevant facts but often fail to find them through web search alone.
articles.advisor_relevance: This highlights both the opportunity and current limits of AI agents in revenue-generating enterprise workflows such as sales development. The findings suggest that LLM performance may depend less on reasoning gains alone and more on data access, retrieval quality, and workflow integration, which are important considerations when evaluating enterprise AI monetization and platform differentiation.
